scope: Independent headless campaign verification; production implementation unchanged by tester.

acceptedRuns.meaning: Actual production stage/menu systems with explicit branch fixtures; includes existing shooting and first-stage regressions.
Focused repeat after final mine guard change.
Three normal-rules complete campaign runs, actual stage/menu systems and ordinary held Space/arrows/B/Enter inputs, no gameplay-state mutation.

fixtureCoverage: Clear score plus stage/hull bonuses applied exactly once for all three bosses; progress dispatch once per terminal attempt.

Real result menu chooses next stage, death retry, and final replay; score carries forward, retry discards failed-stage gains and restores entry score/full hull/Nova, replay starts stage 0 at score 0 while retaining best.
Pause freezes later-stage beam age and simulation time; resume works; return-to-title disposes old stage and releases fixture asset claims.
Minelayer creates a drifting mine with arming delay and eight-shot detonation.
Mine contact damage, destruction by ordinary shots, and Nova cancellation of a due detonation.
Warden beam telegraph causes no early damage, charged lane causes damage, Nova removes it, expiry removes it, and stage clear removes charging beams.
Kiln segment destruction transfers damage to core and reduces later volley contributions.
Starfall Engine crosses three health phases with zero/one/two charged lanes; destroyed emitters reduce ring density.
Engine emitter hit test uses measured artwork socket geometry, transfers damage to core, and destruction persists.

normalRulesSummary.details: All three runs reached the final result screen after actual normal encounters and boss combat. Similar deterministic encounter schedules and limited random drops explain matching stage timing. Exact per-stage records are in headless-final.json.

limitations: Branch fixtures deliberately seed entities, health, timing and scores; these checks are not natural playthroughs.

Normal-rules bot only observes public ECS data and sends ordinary inputs, but exact positions/velocities and predictive planning exceed human observation; success does not establish fair difficulty or fun.
Headless runs replace asset loading and sound with fixtures and do not execute WebGPU rendering, decoded production media or audible output.
Headless route adapter prepares candidate scenes following production semantics; browser verification of createCampaign and real asset ownership belongs to the lead's separate fixture.
Simulation durations exclude menu and hit-stop time and are not performance benchmarks.
Three seeds are bounded reachability evidence, not an exhaustive guarantee.
No human art acceptance, play acceptance or full-game approval is implied by these checks.
Initial campaign test attempt expected the superseded radial minelayer attack; that fixture was corrected to actual mine mechanics and all subsequent checks passed.

reusableBot.browserIntegration: Diff returned held key names into public Input.set; module is browser-safe and never writes game state. Keep manual Enter routing outside decision helper for title/result menus.
